about: Per-vertex uvs (in 16ths, rounded to 0.01) that Java's uvlock bakes for one element face under a blockstate x/y turn, read by running the real client jars in a JVM: MC 1.21.1 FaceBakery#recomputeUVs (ggd.a) then BlockFaceUV#getU/getV(k) (gga.a/b); MC 1.21.8 BlockModelRotation uvlocked ModelState#inverseFaceTransformation (htu$a.b) applied per vertex as FaceBakery#bakeQuad does. Vertex k is FaceInfo's k-th corner of the face as declared. Numbers only; no Mojang code.
